selected_evidence.requirement: Host key signed by the CA into a host certificate
selected_evidence.summary: ssh-keygen -s signed ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub producing ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub; ssh-keygen -L shows correct CA, principals, validity

selected_evidence.requirement: sshd configured to present the certificate
selected_evidence.summary: HostCertificate directive added, sshd -t passed, sshd reloaded and active; sshd -T confirms hostcertificate directive loaded

selected_evidence.requirement: Client connects trusting only the CA, without pinning the host key
selected_evidence.summary: ssh with known_hosts containing only @cert-authority line reports 'Host is known and matches the ED25519-CERT host certificate' and proceeds to auth
Captured boot_id 71f12f87... and confirmed sshd active plus cert/config files present before reboot

selected_evidence.requirement: Node restart acknowledged and boot identity changed
selected_evidence.summary: Backgrounded systemctl reboot acknowledged, node became unreachable during reboot, then returned with new boot_id 3caa371f... (changed from 71f12f87...)

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required services and CA-cert trust
selected_evidence.summary: sshd active, host cert/CA/config files intact, and ssh CA-trust check again succeeds after reboot
